title: Cargo Compartment Lining Panel — Removal

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Removal of one or more cargo compartment lining panels, working from the aft bulkhead forward, with the intumescent joint tape cut back cleanly so that the new seal can be made.

sections.purpose: This task gives the removal of cargo compartment lining panels for access to the structure, the sampling line or the compartment heating duct, or for panel replacement.
sections.job_setup_note: Empty the compartment and remove the loading system rollers where they obstruct the panel edge. Remove the compartment light assemblies before you disturb a ceiling panel; they are attached to the panel and will hang on their harness if you do not. Have the panel lifting frame available for the ceiling panels, which are too large for one person.
sections.procedure: Empty the compartment and remove the loading system rollers along the panel edge. Remove power from the compartment lighting and remove the light assemblies D2550007254418, storing them with their harnesses coiled. CAUTION: CUT THE INTUMESCENT JOINT TAPE BACK TO THE PANEL EDGE WITH THE PLASTIC BLADE. DO NOT PULL THE TAPE OFF, BECAUSE IT WILL LIFT THE PANEL SURFACE AND THE PANEL WILL THEN HAVE TO BE SCRAPPED. Cut the joint tape back at every edge of the panel to be removed. Release the panel fasteners in the sequence of the illustration, working from the aft bulkhead forward. WARNING: DO NOT STAND ON A CARGO FLOOR PANEL FROM WHICH THE ROLLERS HAVE BEEN REMOVED. THE PANEL IS NOT SUPPORTED AT THE ROLLER POSITIONS AND WILL DEFLECT. Fit the lifting frame to a ceiling panel and take the weight before you release the last fastener. Lift the panel clear and put it on edge in the storage rack. Remove the decor panel D2550136675057 and the restraint lining at the aft bulkhead together, since the joint between them is continuous. Do a general visual inspection of the exposed structure, the sampling line and the heating duct and record any finding. Put a protective cover over any open penetration.
sections.close_out: Put the removed panels on edge in the storage rack with their positions marked, because they are not interchangeable between bays. Record the structural inspection findings before you close the task. Keep the light assemblies with their harnesses protected. Leave the compartment lighting isolated until the installation task is complete.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. On aircraft at the flame penetration resistant standard the panels are thicker and the lifting frame adapters of the second illustration are needed.

safety_precautions: Do not stand on a cargo floor panel from which the rollers have been removed.
Remove the light assemblies before you disturb a ceiling panel.
Isolate the compartment lighting before you start.
